title: Planner calibration checkpoint
hypothesis: Five completed outcomes are enough to inspect systematic planner bias before considering any scoring-weight change.

title: Sandbox capability manifests
hypothesis: Named capability manifests can make allowed experiment commands easier to audit without weakening the sandbox allowlist.

title: Journal synthesis snapshot
hypothesis: A deterministic synthesis of completed experiments can surface repeated lessons and missing capabilities without making the journal less auditable.

title: State integrity doctor
hypothesis: A deterministic cross-file integrity check can catch drift between backlog, outcomes, calibration baselines, and generated snapshots before autonomous work builds on inconsistent state.

title: State schema versioning
hypothesis: Explicit schema versions and deterministic migrations can let Lumen evolve its persisted state without silent compatibility failures.

title: Experiment provenance index
hypothesis: A local provenance index linking experiments to evidence artifacts can make completed work easier to audit without making GitHub or generated summaries a source of truth.
